jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Payments
jobs.content:
We're looking for a backend engineer with experience in Python, Go, distributed systems, and PostgreSQL. You'll work on the payments infrastructure serving millions of merchants. 5+ years experience required.

  • Design and build high-throughput payment APIs
  • Partner with product on new payment methods

jobs.title: Frontend Designer
jobs.content: We're hiring a product designer with a strong eye for typography and motion. Figma wizardry and some HTML/CSS experience a plus.
